gt get [branch]

For a given branch or PR number, sync branches from trunk to the given branch from remote, prompting the user
to resolve any conflicts. If the branch passed to get already exists locally, any local branches upstack of th
e branch are also synced; to opt out of this behavior, use the --downstack flag. Note that remote-only branche
s upstack of the branch are not synced by default; to do so, pass the --remote-upstack (-u) flag. If no branch
 is provided, sync the current stack.
